summary: Flat east kerb where cars park; flats and houses 12-20 m away.

best_section.where: East kerb at the south end, beside the L'Chaim Lodge flats

drivers.traffic: Local street, light to moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park here regularly; No Stopping Any Time signs sit on parts of the street, so check the signs on site.
